row_guide: Band0 (y0–768): compact hatchbacks ×6 colors (blue, dark green, emerald, red, orange, grey) ×4 facings; boats (docked rowboat parts, orange dinghy, white skiff, fishing motorboat, large wooden fishing boat); buses ×5 colors (yellow including door-side, pink, cyan, brown+green stripe, grey) ×4 facings; bus shelters + stop signs; ambulance 112 ×4 facings. Band1 (y768–1536): hot-dog food truck + props/vendor; camper/RV ± awnings (trailer-like); tacos truck, ice-cream truck, pizza tuk-tuk; fruit/flower carts & market stalls; street-food tables; gas station building/canopies/pumps/price digits; utility+medical helicopters; helipad corner; payphones & street signs. Band2 (y1536–2304): gas island top-down, car wash, full helipad H, 6 mini car icons + UI arrows; sedan grids (silver/green/lavender/teal/yellow-stripe/tan + model-B slate/teal-stripe/purple/dark-green/yellow/tan) ×4 facings; tire skid decals + yellow motion demo. Band3 (y2304–2688): white sedan + white hatchback; sports coupes ×6 colors (cyan, lime, teal, red, white, orange) ×4 facings. No bikes/motorcycles, pickup/cargo trucks, or cargo trailers on this sheet (see meta.*_none).
